title: Small-etale module operations in an ambient coefficient universe
statement: Let $S$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $X,Y$ algebraic spaces over $S$ [def-trf-algebraic-space], and $f:X\to Y$. Use the small etale ring sheaves and the chart category, scalar maps and restriction diagrams of [def-trf-space-etale-module-functors]. For any ambient module universe $r$ containing the small chart site (Lean UnivLE.{u+1,r}), write ModulesOfSize(X) for all module sheaves [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category] with carriers in $r$, over the unchanged, unlifted small etale ring sheaf. This is an additional ambient-size interface; the existing scheme-universe Modules and all its canonical operations remain unchanged. Additive sheafification and its locally bijective criterion hold, and these categories have enough injectives [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Define the normalized direct-image functor by the same compatible-section limit and every chart projection, retaining naturality in both test schemes and modules. Its limit universal property determines the functor up to unique projection-preserving natural isomorphism. Define tensor pullback as the left adjoint to this fixed direct image, retain its unit and counit and the formula $b\otimes m=b\pi(\eta(m))$. For composable maps retain the unique direct-image composition isomorphism preserving every iterated chart projection and its adjunction mate on tensor pullbacks. Direct image and tensor pullback are additive, and tensor pullback preserves finite colimits. No arbitrary map or unconstrained functor is selected.
